sentences.text:
1. Accused Nos.5 to 7 in C.C.No.76 of 2025 pending before the Court of Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Koppal arising out of Crime No.17 of 2017 registered by C.E.N. Police Station, Koppal for offences punishable under Sections 403, 406, 409, 420, 471, 477A of the Indian Penal Code, are before this Court under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS 2023)
seeking anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Koppal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.17 of 2017 was registered by C.E.N. Police Station, Koppal for the aforesaid offences against Doddabasanagouda S/o Linganagouda based on the first information received from Hanumanthappa S/o Babanna Kambar, who is now arrayed as accused No.1 in the charge sheet.
After completing investigation in the case, charge sheet was filed against 7 persons and NC:
2025:KHC-D:9979 HC-KAR petitioners herein are arrayed as accused Nos.5 to 7 in the charge sheet.
Since non-bailable warrant was issued against them by the learned Magistrate after the charge sheet was filed, petitioners had filed anticipatory bail application before the Court of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Koppal in Criminal Misc.No.157 of 2025, which was rejected on 10.06.2025.
Therefore, petitioners are before this Court.
4.

sentences.text: Panchayath.

Accused Nos.1 and 4, who are working as Panchayat Development Officers have been granted anticipatory bail by this Court, and accused Nos.2 and 3 have been granted regular bail by the Court of Magistrate.
Investigation of the case is already completed.

At the stage of investigation,
the police have not summoned the petitioners for enquiry, nor was any NC: 2025:KHC-D:9979 HC-KAR attempt made to arrest them.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

6. Allegation in the first information which was filed by accused No.1 is that, during the years 2016-17 and 2017-18, a total sum of  46,82,000/- was found to be misappropriated in the Panchayath and it is under these circumstances, FIR was initially registered against accused No.3,
who was working as a computer operator in the Panchayath.

During the course of investigation,
accused Nos.2 and 3 were arrested and they were released on regular bail.
Accused Nos.1 and 4 have been granted anticipatory bail by this Court.

In Criminal Petition No.100278 of 2019 allowed on 08.03.2019, wherein anticipatory bail is against to accused No.4, this Court has taken note of the fact that name of accused No.4 was not found in the FIR, and as on the date of he filing anticipatory bail application, he had already repaid the NC: 2025:KHC-D:9979 HC-KAR amount of 3,38,000/-,
which allegedly was misappropriated by him.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioners has made a submission before this Court that even the petitioners have repaid the amount allegedly misappropriated by them.
It is not in dispute that name of the petitioners is not found in the FIR.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge has been filed.
Petitioners are the employees of Gram Panchayath and during the course of investigation police had not made any attempt either to arrest them or to summon them for the purpose of investigation.
It is only since the learned Magistrate has issued non-bailable warrant against the petitioners, they apprehend arrest in the present case.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioners for grant of anticipatory bail needs to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i. Petition is allowed.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:9979 HC-KAR ii.

The respondent - Police or any other Police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in C.C.No.76 of 2025 pending before the Court of Additional Civil Judge and JMFC,
Koppal arising out of Crime No.17 of 2017 registered by C.E.N. Police Station, Koppal for offences punishable under Sections 403, 406, 409, 420, 471, 477A of the Indian Penal Code, subject to the following conditions:
a.
